title: Cloud Customer Management System (CCMS): to avoid reinventing the wheel
summary: CCMS is an open-source, free cloud customer management system built in AL that helps Business Central partners automate management of customer tenants and environments, including scheduling environment copies, tracking installed apps, and managing updates across multiple cloud instances.
key_points: The app is open source and free to use or fork for contributions
It provides tenant and environment management capabilities integrated into Business Central
Features include environment scheduling, installed apps tracking, available updates management, telemetry, capacity monitoring, and feature management
Developed by Directions for Partners in collaboration with the community

quotes.text: developed in AL, that orchestrates the handling of customer tenants and environments tightly integrated in Dynamics 365 Business Central.
quotes.why_it_matters: Defines the core purpose and architecture of the CCMS application

quotes.text: The repo is open for contribution since 11th December 2025
quotes.why_it_matters: Signals that the community can actively participate in development and shape the future of the tool
